name: brdcomp-alert
title: Alert
description: Inline callout bar for info, success, warning, or critical (error) states. Supports optional icon, links/actions, and dismiss button for transient messages.

examples.title: Dismissible alert with link
examples.code:
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription, AlertActions, AlertLink } from "@/components/ui/alert"

<Alert variant="warning" dismissible>
  <AlertTitle>Warning</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>Review changes before saving.</AlertDescription>
  <AlertActions>
    <AlertLink href="/learn-more">Learn more</AlertLink>
  </AlertActions>
</Alert>
